shots.name: The Setup
shots.visual: A person holds two cards, one labeled B.Com and one BBA. A third card flips onto the screen between them.
shots.dialogue: Everyone says B.Com is for accounting and BBA is for management. But look at this.
shots.cameraPerformance: Close-up on the person's hands and the cards.

shots.name: The Method
shots.visual: The person points to the task card, looking puzzled as they try to place it under either label.
shots.dialogue: Is a financial report exclusive to one? Without a source, we are just guessing labels. That is not proof.
shots.cameraPerformance: Medium shot, expressive and questioning look.

shots.name: The Resolution
shots.visual: The person clears the cards and looks directly at the camera.
shots.dialogue: Stop guessing. Ask: what specific evidence links this task to one degree? Find the curriculum link before you decide.
shots.onscreenText: What specific evidence links this task to one degree?
